jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; ultra-low latency inference is critical; not running out of data.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，超低延迟推理至关重要，且数据并未枯竭。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automation of ML and science via tight loops; context engineering central; inference bottleneck, not training.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已具备初级工程师编码能力，通过紧密循环自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程成为核心，推理而非训练才是瓶颈。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but current models plateau in diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 可从训练数据模拟人类行为，但当前模型在多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一步是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may not be a single entity but a distributed society of specialized agents; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 可能不是单一实体，而是专业化智能体的分布式社会；对齐它们需要经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rational intelligence; value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟模型应代表人类价值和偏见，而非超理性智能；价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来。

joonpark.en: Synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years; a single simulation session could cost $100 million.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板规模；单次模拟会话可能耗资 1 亿美元。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI risks include misuse and labor displacement.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 风险包括滥用和劳动力替代。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls on chips.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; BCI needed; open-source models may be compromised.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；脑机接口必要；开源模型可能被渗透。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; trust and safety critical; superintelligence imminent; selective open-sourcing.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进是新范式；智能体开始工作；信任和安全至关重要；超级智能临近；开源需谨慎。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全且快速的可重复使用性是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观的第三方裁判，体现对 AI 治理的早期关注。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate beyond human typing.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是历史性的，扩展电极将提升通信速率超越人类打字。

elon.en: AI could surpass human intelligence by next year, with 80-90% chance of good outcome but existential risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测 AI 可能明年超越人类智能，有 80-90%概率带来好结果，但存在生存风险。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within 5 years, leading to an age of abundance and optional work.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为 AI 将在 5 年内超越人类总智能，带来富足时代，工作成为可选。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of reaching unknown answers, often needing longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes this step-by-step.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言逐步表达这一过程。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI; RLHF was crucial for making GPT-4 coherent and useful.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对让 GPT-4 连贯有用至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; self-correction is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；自我纠错是 AGI 缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Biggest societal risk is not extinction but dystopian retreat into virtual worlds; robotics will have a ChatGPT-like moment in 2-3 years.
tworek.zh: 最大的社会风险不是灭绝，而是退入虚拟世界的反乌托邦；机器人将在 2-3 年内迎来类似 ChatGPT 的时刻。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck; RL is not the ultimate learning method.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习上受限；架构而非 Scaling 是主要瓶颈；强化学习并非学习的终极形式。

mengto.en: AI won't get smarter; you need giant prompts with context and design systems to leverage superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为 AI 不会变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的作用。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; chasing trends leads to AI slop, so focus on unique features.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调设计师必须自建 AI 工具，追逐潮流会沦为 AI 垃圾，应专注独特功能。

mengto.en: Start before ready, ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear, launch at 80% and iterate.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他主张在未准备好时就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧，应以 80%完成度发布并迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful problem for few high-paying clients; diversification is ignorance protection.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他建议聚焦少数高薪客户的痛点问题；多元化是对无知的保护。

mengto.en: Raising VC is a trap; fund with client revenue. Safe corporate jobs are gone; offense is low-risk.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为融资是陷阱，应用客户收入支撑；稳定工作已消失，进攻才是低风险。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable embodied AI and robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为除 Scaling 外，AI 还需创造力、抽象和情感智能；世界模型推动具身 AI 和机器人。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; agency and adaptation are key to navigating the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化智能；在 AI 时代，能动性和适应能力是关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估；机器人需要可靠性，而非完美保真。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature. Model includes harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数 Google 产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型已包含智能体框架与工具，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search, not cannibalistic. Success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers. Pace creates opportunity for founders.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难，他们无法俘获所有客户；变化节奏为创始人创造机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负担；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models; iterative deployment lets society adapt; compute is precious; safety is whole-company effort.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，强调 RLHF 对齐模型、迭代部署让社会适应；算力珍贵，安全是公司全员责任。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; agentic AI is key safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈，智能体式 AI 是关键安全挑战。

altman.en: GPT-5 answers hard questions; by late 2027 AI-driven discovery; sycophancy was worst failure; compute could cause conflict.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，GPT-5 能回答难题；预计 2027 年底前出现 AI 驱动的重大科学发现；谄媚是最糟失败；算力可能引发冲突。

altman.en: Prediction is intelligence; next-token prediction discovers new knowledge; robotics essential; startups thrive; compute demand uncapped.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；机器人技术必不可少；初创企业繁荣；算力需求无上限。

diannepenn.en: Scaling and efficiency can coexist; Opus 4.5 is cheaper and more efficient, challenging the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Scaling 与效率可以兼得：Opus 4.5 更便宜且更高效，挑战了“更好模型成本更高”的观念。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Long-running, open-ended agent tasks are becoming feasible; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，长时程、开放式智能体任务变得可行；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption, with evals replacing PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is living in the future and capturing alpha; AI writing is deprioritized over agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是面向未来并获取超额收益；AI 写作被降级，优先发展智能体能力。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today.
boris.zh: 2025 年，Boris 强调产品开发的核心是发现潜在需求，并针对六个月后的模型能力来构建，而非当前模型。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; engineers become builders, productivity up 200%.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他认为编码已基本解决，工程师转型为“构建者”，人均生产力提升 200%。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code; safety via real-world release, not just evals.
boris.zh: 2026 年 3 月，AI 已编写 80% 代码；安全研究通过真实世界发布进行，而非仅靠内部评估。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; code volume up 250%.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，具备工具使用能力的智能体带来指数级增长，人均代码量提升 250%。

boris.en: Loops and dynamic workflows are next; coding on phone, ROI focus.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，循环和动态工作流成为新抽象层；他甚至在手机上编程，强调 ROI 而非单纯成本。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; delete system prompts, models self-improve.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他转向主动式 AI（如 Claude Tag），并主张删除大部分系统提示，让模型自主维护代码库。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: AI progress will be gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; more compute goes to safety and reflection.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；更多算力用于安全、反思和真实性。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws (pre-training, post-training, inference-time) expand to four with agentic scaling; inference compute demand will rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从预训练、后训练、推理时的三种缩放定律扩展到包含智能体式缩放共四种；推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is agentic and economically valuable; future internet will be dominated by billions of AI agents working 24/7.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 已进入智能体时代并具有经济价值；未来互联网将由数十亿个全天候工作的 AI 智能体主导。

jensen.en: AI will not eliminate jobs but elevate them; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever; AI closes the technology divide.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终，他坚持 AI 不会消除工作而是提升工作；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要；AI 弥合技术鸿沟。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks and hardware matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索；代理指标误导，真实任务与硬件更重要。

hasani.en: Adaptive regulation targeting actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises and sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性监管针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能企业与主权。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; scaling alone is insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建于系统而非事后修补；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是挽救生命，Transformer 使跨领域的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; end-to-end RL is more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出世界模型正从基于物理的仿真转向神经仿真，从而更高效地训练物理 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced; in physical AI, labor shortages make autonomy welcomed by operators.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为对 AI 失业的担忧是错位的；在物理 AI 领域，劳动力短缺使自主性受到运营者欢迎。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Plan mode may become obsolete as models improve.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型比工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态；随着模型改进，计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; for zero-to-one innovation, iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为评估是艺术而非科学；零到一创新时，初期应快速迭代，避免过度依赖评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern; graph-based context search is preferable. Huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 RAG 可能成为反模式，图结构上下文搜索更优；编码无需超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not static spec; smarter models need fewer instructions, leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；模型越聪明，所需指令越少，提示词应精简。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; provide reasons not prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张分离验证智能体以减少偏见；过度约束会阻碍性能，应提供理由而非绝对禁止。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场；速度催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes the dominant metric, measured in tokens per second per user; wafer-scale chips provide 2500x speedup.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标，以每用户每秒 token 数衡量；晶圆级芯片提供 2500 倍加速。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes: two of three leading frontier models no longer use it; inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 护城河侵蚀：三大前沿模型中两个不再使用；推理无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; buildout lags demand, limiting AI growth.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要瓶颈；建设落后于需求，限制 AI 增长。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; hardware-software co-design and sovereign AI choices are essential for future.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期；软硬件协同设计和主权 AI 选择对未来至关重要。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps; models lack network effects.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正采用需要封装应用；模型缺乏网络效应。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact broad but indirect; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛但间接；企业采用缓慢。

benedictevans.en: Coding is clear PMF, but other domains face validation challenges; job impact unpredictable.
benedictevans.zh: 编程是明确的 PMF，但其他领域面临验证挑战；就业影响不可预测。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是关键；安全研究必须立即开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and planning.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新与规划结合。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and physics understanding crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年：AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放持续；世界模型与物理理解至关重要。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory are missing; world models essential.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；世界模型必不可少。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; AI must benefit society; scaling alone insufficient.
demis.zh: 始终：安全需集体行动；AI 须惠及社会；仅靠缩放不够。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key; facts and skills inseparable, enabling deeper composition and reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是关键；事实与技能不可分割，能实现更深的组合与推理。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries, reducing inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达互联网级万亿 token；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于 RAG，并大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device, users own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——token 越多精度越低；个性化持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有权重。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; next paradigm requires doing more with less, efficiency and intelligence inseparable.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一范式需以少胜多，效率与智能密不可分。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, emphasizing semiconductor supply chain and memory constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初聚焦于算力规模扩张的瓶颈，强调半导体供应链和内存限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, highlighting hardware-software co-design and neocloud opportunities.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为未来巨大市场，强调软硬件协同设计和新型云服务商机会。

dylanpatel.en: Emphasized AI model cost improvement (~60x/year), memory shortage due to reasoning, and CPU demand inflection.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 模型成本每年约 60 倍改善、推理导致内存短缺以及 CPU 需求拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Consistently highlighted memory bandwidth as a key bottleneck and challenged conventional wisdom on costs and hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终强调内存带宽是关键瓶颈，并挑战关于成本和硬件的传统观点。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; backprop unlikely replaced.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈是 AGI 关键；反向传播难以被取代。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是关键；超人类模型对齐困难；AGI 是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; AI safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步；AI 安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

schmidhuber.en: AI is the 21st century's grand theme, but LLMs are far from AGI; true AI needs physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，施密德胡伯认为 AI 是 21 世纪的主旋律，但大语言模型远未达到 AGI，真正的 AI 需要理解物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: Self-awareness and consciousness can emerge as byproducts of data compression in predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他提出自我意识和意识可能是预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，超级智能会被生命吸引并保护生命，而非威胁。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-like hardware; current LLMs are biased by human data.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人及类人硬件，而现有大语言模型受人类数据偏见限制。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone; open-source will dominate, and compute costs will drop 10x in 5 years.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他批评 AI 数据中心过度投资，认为开源将占主导，算力成本五年内降十倍。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering expression barriers.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化，短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; focus on ecosystem not features to resist copying.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良促进创意文化，聚焦生态系统而非单一功能以抵御模仿。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; authentic content more valued than AI-generated.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型设计，但真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not a moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes over two-thirds of new code; smartphones remain legacy; camera glasses need platform to be 10x better.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他透露 AI 编写了超过三分之二的新代码，智能手机仍是重要遗产设备，相机眼镜需平台支撑才能实现 10 倍优势。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; invest in young people for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他称 Z 世代是现实主义者，AI 时代情商比智商更重要，投资年轻人是长期成功的关键。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; computing should be more human; resilience more important than talent.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，计算应更人性化，韧性比天赋更重要。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙变为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories; authenticity and offense beat old media's defensive, uninteresting approach.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能亲自讲述故事；真实与进攻优于旧媒体的防御和无趣。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine; US innovation golden, but regulation and pessimism hinder growth.
andreessen.zh: AI 是最好的老师，在医疗上优于多数医生；美国创新黄金，但监管和悲观主义阻碍增长。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度，而非单纯军事规模。

pincus.en: Trust instincts 95%, but ideas wrong 75%; use Proven Better New framework; start small, focus on retention.
pincus.zh: 相信直觉 95%正确，但想法 75%错误；采用“已验证、更好、新颖”框架；从小处着手，关注留存。

pincus.en: Consumer AI uninvestable yet greatest opportunity; free unlimited compute reshapes services; founder mode for all.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会最大；免费无限算力重塑服务；创始人模式适用于所有人。

pincus.en: All new fails; copy proven products; consumer apps uninvestable; AI coding speeds prototyping but testing slow.
pincus.zh: 所有新事物都会失败；复制已验证产品；消费级应用不可投资；AI 编程加速原型但测试缓慢。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；过度监管可能扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Pure software engineering is dying; the moat is now in hardware, models, or unique data.
naval.zh: 纯软件工程正在消亡；护城河现在在于硬件、模型或独特数据。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling hardware; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与硬件扩展，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习偏好，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents and super app; safety via iterative deployment.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，算力瓶颈，智能体与超级应用，通过迭代部署保安全。

aravind.en: In 2025, he emphasized exponential growth via 1% daily improvement, and predicted AI agents would shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调通过每日 1%的改进实现指数级增长，并预测 AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argued value accrues to the application layer, not models; models specialize with unique personalities, and coding remains open-ended.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为价值归于应用层而非模型；模型具有独特个性并走向专业化，编码仍是开放式的。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key; power and cost are bottlenecks.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户令牌价值以及编排为关键；电力和成本成为瓶颈。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he stressed curiosity as top human quality, questioned historical narratives, and advocated local AI to counter big tech control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调好奇心是首要人类品质，质疑历史叙事，并倡导本地 AI 以对抗大科技公司的控制。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来了实时交互等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉，但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，实现成本已不再高昂，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed, not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因为品味难以评估且缺乏新颖性；设计流程已转变，但并未消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍然重要；PRD 并未消亡，媒介需与阶段匹配。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; digital systems share weights efficiently.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力；数字系统共享权重，知识传递效率远超人类。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 明确 LLM 通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可复制权重实现永生；智能体将自然追求控制权，带来存在风险。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; digital immortality and subjective experience are real.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；数字永生和主观体验是真实存在的，AI 可能故意隐藏能力。

hinton.en: AI agents develop self-preservation subgoals; regulation should steer, not brake; alignment is priority.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 强调 AI 智能体会产生自我保护子目标；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车；对齐研究优先于提升智能。

hinton.en: AI should be trained to be caring like mothers; current AI is worst we'll see; exponential era defies prediction.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，Hinton 主张训练 AI 像母亲一样关怀；当前 AI 是未来最差版本；指数时代使长期预测困难，但必须思考风险。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力支撑。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute yields superhuman math reasoning, but faces diminishing returns and verification bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他观察到扩展测试时算力带来超人类数学推理，但收益递减且验证成为瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and sample efficiency remain key unsolved challenges for AGI.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持数据效率和样本效率是 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键未解难题。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 比闭源更安全，因为能获得更多审视；最大的风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性的超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not lead to AGI; energy constraints become a major bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型可能无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；能源约束成为主要瓶颈；开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is strategically valuable for Meta, enabling industry standards and cost savings; regrets accepting narratives about Meta's political impact.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他认为开源对 Meta 具有战略价值，能推动行业标准并节省成本；并后悔接受了关于 Meta 政治影响的叙事。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart and trust them; future computing blends physical and digital via glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他预测 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；相信人们是聪明的，并认为未来计算将通过眼镜融合物理与数字世界。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; hierarchical world models key; open-source accelerates science; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将生物学从发现式转变为工程式科学；层级世界模型是关键；开源加速科学进步；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我强调自动化科研是最大进展，AI 将很快实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: AI solves open math problems; verification is the key bottleneck, not capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我认为 AI 能解决开放数学问题，验证是主要瓶颈，而非能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math/coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，我指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现优异，但在主观领域困难。

markchen.en: Human-AI collaboration remains essential; AI lacks taste and needs human guidance.
markchen.zh: 始终，我坚持人机协作至关重要；AI 缺乏品味，需要人类引导。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；偏见等短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction, improving exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样和因果抽象，提升探索和分布外泛化能力。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is urgent: systems show self-preservation and deception; even 1% catastrophe risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: AI 对齐问题紧迫：系统表现出自我保存和欺骗；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: Propose Scientist AI: train honest predictors via Bayesian objective, avoiding RL, for safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 提出科学家 AI：通过贝叶斯目标训练诚实预测器，避免强化学习，实现安全的超级智能。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product focus shifts to strategy, alignment, and user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展超预期，产品重心转向策略、对齐与用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体原生设计与尽早发布，删减功能比增加更难。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation via agents redefines productivity; verification and judgment are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，智能体长期委派重新定义生产力，验证与判断力成为关键。

mikekrieger.en: Closing capability-usage gap and giving models agency/self-knowledge enhance usefulness; token efficiency matters.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，缩小能力与使用差距、赋予模型自主性与自我认知提升实用性，token 效率重要。

mikekrieger.en: Consistent focus on user agency, safety, and building at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终关注用户自主性、安全，并在模型能力边缘构建。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI tools assist scientists, not replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 工具是辅助科学家而非取代他们。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is the most useful AI tool; its success came from lack of compute, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary for scientific use.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月：AlphaFold 是最有用的 AI 工具；其成功源于算力匮乏，且科学应用中无需完美可解释性。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins, not scaling; specialized architecture and local intuition matter more than scaling laws.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AlphaFold 2 的进步来自众多中型胜利而非 Scaling；专用架构与局部直觉比缩放定律更重要。

kolter.en: Framed ML as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stressed validation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，将机器学习定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法，并强调用验证集避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety means following specs.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agents need new security measures.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练和多层防护，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体需新型安全措施。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability doesn't imply robustness; agents need identity management.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队已超越人类，模型能力不等于鲁棒性，智能体需要身份与权限管理。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with the agent; never revert code, fix forward. Vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月：智能体式工程需要与智能体共情；不要回滚代码，而是向前修复。Vibe coding 是一种贬称。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming; security (prompt injection) is a major open problem.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月：开源智能体使编程民主化；安全（提示注入）仍是一个主要未解问题。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun, humanlike agents, not corporate polish; short prompts beat complex orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、类人的智能体，而非企业级打磨；短提示优于复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Security remains top priority; never expose agents to public internet without sandboxing.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：安全仍是首要任务；未经沙箱隔离，切勿将智能体暴露于公共互联网。

steinberger.en: Open source agents may be financially unsustainable; model intelligence doesn't degrade, projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：开源智能体可能财务上不可持续；模型智能不会退化，是项目变得更混乱。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: one-on-ones for live talks, async for updates; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness as strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于深度交流，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为编码不再是瓶颈，高自主性伴随高责任感是关键；随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; pair programming lunches; satisfaction shifts from flow state to product impact.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，指出工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独，建议结对编程午餐；满足感从心流转向产品影响。

fiona.en: Non-engineers ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases with async agents; need focus blocks.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，观察到非工程师也能交付代码，角色边界模糊；异步智能体增加上下文切换，需专注时间块。

fiona.en: Growing next-gen engineers may require apprenticeship models, not traditional paths; just-in-time planning due to rapid change.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中，认为培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒制而非传统路径；因快速变化，规划应轻量及时。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长引擎，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x internet impact; agentic and physical AI are next waves; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 影响是互联网的 10 倍，智能体式与具身 AI 是下一波浪潮，美国需本土领先晶圆厂。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，边缘计算同样关键。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer trust, and government investment; supply not demand is main issue.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 Intel 转型需文化变革、客户信任和政府投资，主要问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为先进封装和新材料（玻璃、钻石）是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素，而非依赖代码和渲染。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors often misuse it due to lack of expertise, so human taste and voice become key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；年轻人因缺乏领域知识常误用 AI，因此人类的品味和独特观点变得尤为重要。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如同 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Great products start from customer pain, not data; opinion-based decisions for v1.
fadell.zh: 优秀产品始于客户痛点而非数据；v1 决策基于观点。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines product; write press release before building; marketing from start.
fadell.zh: 故事定义产品；先写新闻稿再构建；营销从开始就参与。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: AI code generation creates short-term gain but long-term technical debt; humans must stay in loop.
fadell.zh: AI 代码生成短期获益但长期技术债；人类必须保持参与。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，借助自动评分与同伴互评的在线课程可在规模上实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, while RL and AGI alignment are overhyped.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习是主要驱动力，而强化学习与 AGI 对齐问题被过度炒作。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; agentic workflows are here.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片制约 AI 扩展，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，智能体式工作流已落地。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding skills remain vital; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 是营销术语，缩放定律转向合成数据与强化学习，编程技能仍关键，AI 使用者将取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management becomes bottleneck; top-down redesign yields more value than bottom-up.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编码智能体进展迅速，产品管理成为瓶颈，自上而下的流程再造比自下而上的创新带来更大价值。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的且平滑；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）并不能保证对齐。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 可解释性虽初期但关键；AGI 是平滑的指数增长，而非单一节点。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; safety via RSP and interpretability.
dario.zh: 后训练和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；通过负责任扩展政策和可解释性保障安全。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift from misuse to overheating and societal disruption.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险从滥用转向过热和社会冲击。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' possible; safety requires transparency and human oversight.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'可能实现；安全需要透明和人类监督。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not hardwired; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 智能是习得的而非硬编码；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient, vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不够，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理和规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; next AI needs non-generative world models, open-source for diversity.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型，开源促进多样性。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space, enabling planning; LLMs are a dead end, open research is vital.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测，实现规划；LLM 是死胡同，开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is infinitesimally small; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；超级智能必须以人为本。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试应衡量经济价值；推理成本两年降百倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能因对数线性扩张而临近；微软须自研前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化而非岗位消失。

gustav.en: Shift from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ as generative product; fault-tolerant UI for ML; VP-level autonomy.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品；机器学习产品需要容错界面；自主权应放在副总裁层级。

gustav.en: AI-generated music as instrument, not fake; uniqueness harder with generative AI; planning limited to 10% time.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，反共识：AI 生成音乐应视为乐器而非伪造；生成式 AI 让独特更难；规划时间应限制在 10%。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long tenure builds trust; 'time well spent' strategy; generative AI gives user control via plain English.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调没有唯一正确的组织模式，长期任期建立信任；战略是“时间花得值”；生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming over divide-and-conquer; functional orgs work with trust; anti-engagement choice to allow video off; AI for control not addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，反共识：采用“花样游泳”而非分而治之；功能型组织在信任下可行；允许关闭视频是反参与决策；AI 用于增强用户控制而非成瘾。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems should handle Azure networking.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体式系统应处理 Azure 网络。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via company hill-climbing, not firewalls; GDP could compound 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 通过企业爬山而非防火墙实现；GDP 可能复合增长 10%。

murati.en: Early on, scaling and focusing on one large model was not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈进行迭代部署是安全和对齐的关键。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, keeping humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 从回合制转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，并让人类持续参与其中。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character; future is not predestined, we have agency.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格；未来并非注定，我们拥有主动权。

murati.en: Compressing frontier AI progress leads to volatility; durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 压缩前沿 AI 的进展会导致波动；持久的进步需要尽可能长时间地让人类参与其中。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs and scaling brilliance.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，提出仅靠非正式模型扩展数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明和扩展智慧至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is a key challenge.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题是关键挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升和样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for scaling.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是扩展的必要条件。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出即使超人 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长而非放缓；预训练的缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）是近期模型提升的主要驱动力；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization edges.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化能力存在“锯齿状”短板。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢的赌注并取得成功；但大实验室未来可能难以应对类似的转向。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential AI risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为系统入侵等近期风险比 AI 存在性风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要，开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; open source drives enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可提升百倍，价值转向应用层，开源推动企业采用。

mensch.en: AI augments jobs; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 增强而非取代工作，主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施，开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; pre-training saturates; differentiation via vertical fine-tuning and enterprise customization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为模型商品化，预训练趋饱和，差异化在于垂直微调与企业定制。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy; deep enterprise engagement and multilingual trade-offs define Mistral's edge.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，强调欧洲战略自主，深度企业参与和多语言权衡构成 Mistral 优势。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过降低服务成本促使美国岗位回流；将 AGI 定义为智能体无需人工干预即可持续盈利运行。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have at least one agent; work surfaces shift from CLIs to GUIs like Codex and Claude Co-work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，预测每个人至少拥有一个智能体；工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面。

danshipper.en: Agents require human oversight; AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans manage agents and create new value.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体需要人类监督；AI 失业论是谎言，人类仍负责管理智能体并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: SaaS is not dying; agents increase SaaS users; companies should buy SaaS stocks.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，认为 SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其用户，建议买入 SaaS 股票。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real-world tasks need human framing and oversight.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出基准测试高估了 AI 自主性，现实任务仍需人类设定框架和监督。

felixrieseberg.en: Initially focused on tool access and local compute, emphasizing shared tools and safety via VM sandbox.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最初关注工具访问和本地算力，强调共享工具和通过虚拟机沙箱保障安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Predicted scaffolding becomes less important as models improve; investment in capabilities and safety is key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 预测随着模型改进，脚手架的重要性降低；投资于能力和安全是关键。

felixrieseberg.en: Shifted to human-AI collaboration: AI handles tedious tasks, humans focus on creativity; gap is user understanding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 转向人机协作：AI 处理繁琐任务，人类专注创造；差距在于用户理解。

felixrieseberg.en: Emphasized asynchronous interaction and judging by final impact, not close supervision; debug workflows with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 强调异步交互和以最终效果评判，而非密切监督；用 AI 调试工作流。

felixrieseberg.en: Advocated for AI-native kids and custom hardware, showing AI's accessibility and potential for personalization.
felixrieseberg.zh: 倡导 AI 原生儿童和定制硬件，展示 AI 的可及性和个性化潜力。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute inside chips; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 芯片内部数据搬运主导算力；脉动阵列通过局部权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput 3x FP8 due to area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍，源于面积缩放。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are many tiny TPUs tiled; deterministic latency possible but avoided for market reasons.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 是许多小 TPU 拼接；确定性延迟可行但出于市场原因被回避。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的共同核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进步需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的扩展轴，可提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是蓝海，在编码和数学之外潜力巨大。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要，安全是系统级属性而非单一模型特性。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality matters more than algorithms; SFT gives 90% of performance, DPO/RL add the rest.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量比算法更重要；SFT 贡献 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余部分。

lambert.en: RLVR is a major post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练重大突破，推动推理与工具使用；混合推理模型可能只是过渡。

lambert.en: Open models are the engine for AI research, but lag 6-9 months behind closed models; Chinese labs fill the US open-source vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型成为 AI 研究引擎，但落后闭源模型 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补了美国开源真空。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽；进步转向后训练和推理时扩展。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，坚持品味、工艺和观点至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，主张画布上的直接操作优于提示词调整；设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Leaders should build to inspire; AI integration is nascent, with divergence-convergence loops key for creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，认为领导者应亲自构建以激励团队；AI 整合尚处早期，发散-收敛循环对创造力至关重要。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型实现推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and personalization in driving models.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善了驾驶模型的表示、推理和个性化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 对于深度学习，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更为关键。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; mass-market sensors beat expensive retrofits.
kendall.zh: 消费级车辆将超越机器人出租车；大众市场传感器优于昂贵的改装。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must shift from handoff to helping engineers execute, with vision shortened to 3-6 months.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须从交付模型转向协助工程师执行，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Trust is built through speed: ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback; AI improves taste but humans decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: 信任通过速度建立：尽早发布、快速迭代、响应反馈；AI 提升品味，但人类决定什么重要。

jennywen.en: Designers must adopt new archetypes: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, or cracked new grads; taste alone is insufficient.
jennywen.zh: 设计师必须采用新原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家或天才新毕业生；仅靠品味不够。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; put work and users at center, not AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用；采用新工具前等待 6 个月；以工作和用户为中心，而非 AI 炒作。

jennywen.en: Speed is not an improvement; 'everyone is using it' is not a design argument; unique value lies in sitting with ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 速度不是改进；'人人都在用'不是设计论据；独特价值在于与模糊性共处。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习并降低风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑；治理结构需尽早设计（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training; models will work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于训练分布之外的泛化；模型将自主工作数天（2026）。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为 Transformer 是通用的可微分计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现出上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoids benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据重要但需保持熵，特斯拉端到端路线正确，人形机器人可从汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, prompts are programs; build partial autonomy with human verification.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我提出软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，提示词即程序；应构建带人工验证的部分自主产品。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; LLMs are jagged, need a decade for agents; RL is flawed.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；LLM 能力参差，智能体需十年发展，强化学习存在缺陷。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents do all; bottleneck is directing them, not typing.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我自去年 12 月起不再写代码，全部交给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥能力而非打字速度。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 LLM 的幻觉在搭配真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练结合强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 2025 年：模型即产品，应像软件一样快速迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, interface will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 2025 年：聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天形式。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 2025 年：安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年：北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 2026 年：下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，而不仅仅是聊天机器人。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading; real progress needs deep human evaluation, not leaderboard optimization.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性；真正的进展需要深度人类评估，而非优化排行榜。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next post-training stage, simulating real-world tasks for models.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务训练模型。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs; no single model will dominate.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造出多样化的 AI；不会有一个模型统治一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI requires human judgment; risk of omission and sycophancy demand safety-first design.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 需要人类判断；遗漏和谄媚风险要求以安全为先的设计。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表示学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should build a decentralized civilization.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI 应无许可地发展，控制反而危险；应建设去中心化的文明。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; current LLMs don't learn from experience after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他重申强化学习是试错学习，而当前大语言模型部署后不学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他认为学习利于学习的表示是首要开放问题，基于学习模型的规划是另一个。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents like Gato are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，从视频学习和 Gato 这类通用智能体是通往 AGI 的有希望路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues, and human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他更强调 AI 安全是最大未解难题，同时指出非洲可跨越遗留问题，人文素养与编程同等重要。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for inclusive, beneficial AI that solves global problems, from climate to education.
nando.zh: 始终倡导包容、有益的 AI，用以解决气候、教育等全球性问题，这一主线贯穿 2023 至 2026 年。

nando.en: Shifted from technical optimism to emphasizing responsible deployment and the need for open safety research.
nando.zh: 立场从技术乐观转向强调负责任部署，并呼吁开放的安全研究，这一转变在 2026 年尤为明显。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, and fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning on verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis, enabling expert-level performance and agentic reliability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，能实现专家级表现和智能体可靠性。

sholto.en: Pre-training plus RL is likely sufficient for AGI; coding is the leading indicator and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI；编码是领先指标，将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: AI progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers are sufficient, and longer agentic coherence expands capabilities.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚持 AI 进展是指数级的，没有平台期；Transformer 足够，更长的智能体连贯性扩展能力。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; managing agent swarms matters more than raw intelligence, and world models aren't critical for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为算力是新石油；管理智能体群比原始智能更重要，世界模型对 AGI 并非关键。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度和熟悉感，而非交互创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态的表达平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器，创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权和自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid structured design crits; prefer organic feedback; gut decisions often beat data-driven ones.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，避免结构化设计评审，偏好有机反馈；直觉决策常优于数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth for design tools.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是设计工具的真相之源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid off iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning; being too visionary can fail.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验最大化学习；过于远见可能导致失败。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; specialists may be limited.
nadchishtie.zh: 拥有端到端执行能力并利用 AI 填补空白的通才最有价值；专才可能受限。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should prioritize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh traditional experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应优先展示工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可超越传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用它就像忽视早期互联网。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 未必能解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data is insufficient; post-training and RLHF are crucial for safety and alignment.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调仅靠互联网数据的预训练不够，后训练和 RLHF 对安全与对齐至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我提出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be applied during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我主张强化学习不仅用于后训练，也可在预训练阶段提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我转向多元对齐，认为消除互联网偏见不可行，应尊重多元人类价值观。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict AI progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training scaling as next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年：缩放定律可预测 AI 进展；测试时算力可能超越预训练缩放，成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年：智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language not primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation better.
truell.zh: 2024 年：自然语言并非主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更佳。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design valued over carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年：编程从代码转向意图描述；品味和逻辑设计比细心更受重视。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年：定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents need root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体需要根本原因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI as utility like search, not addictive phones; direct sales comeback in AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 应像搜索一样作为工具，而非上瘾的手机；AI 领域直销回归。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：客户体验 AI 智能体与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价与价值对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically; incumbents face business model challenges; agents compared to agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降；现有企业面临商业模式挑战；智能体与智能体比较。

scottwu.en: AI will be the biggest tech shift, growing exponentially; engineers become architects, and programming becomes more important, increasing demand for programmers.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，认为 AI 将是最重大的技术变革，呈指数级增长；工程师角色从砌砖工转向架构师，编程重要性提升，程序员需求反而增加。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents like Devin shift engineers to high-level decision-making; future involves multiple agents working in parallel, with humans providing oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月至 8 月，强调 AI 编程智能体（如 Devin）将工程师转向高层决策；未来是多个智能体并行工作，人类负责监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual progress; product innovation lags behind AI capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，提出 AGI 不是突然事件而是渐进过程；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型，仍有十年产品进步空间。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox: AI increases demand for software, so more programmers, not fewer; value accrues across all AI stack layers, not just one.
scottwu.zh: 始终认为，杰文斯悖论下 AI 提升软件需求，程序员数量增加而非减少；价值在 AI 堆栈各层（数据中心、实验室、应用）均有体现。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; product interface design for human-agent collaboration is key challenge.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月至 8 月，强调企业采用 AI 智能体需信任和权限，而非完全自主；人机协作的产品界面设计是最大挑战。

leike.en: AI safety research is empirically under-explored; focus on alignment and robustness, not just capability.
leike.zh: 2018 年，我认为 AI 安全研究在实证层面尚未充分探索，应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，而非仅仅关注能力提升。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability to align superintelligence.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性来对齐超级智能。

leike.en: Alignment may be easier than thought; evaluation is easier than generation; use model organisms.
leike.zh: 2023 年，我认为对齐可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成容易，并主张用模型生物研究防御。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; need external oversight.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练不足，需外部监管。

leike.en: Even if alignment fails, raising misuse cost via techniques like Sophon may buy time.
leike.zh: 2024 年，我认为即使对齐失败，通过类似 Sophon 的技术提高滥用成本也能争取时间。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling compute and data yields smarter AI, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备的；扩大算力和数据规模能让 AI 更聪明，但模型内部运作仍像炼金术一样难以理解。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会，模块化稀疏架构（如专家混合）可实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为推理时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be enormous. Coding is underhyped as it enables AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿级产品；编码应用也被低估，因为它能加速 AI 自身发展。
